name: Sakaguchi Haruo
source:
"Milady! Please don't do anything rash!"

[Personality] Pervert

The young leading subordinate of Onigashima's henchmen and [url=/c39879]Hikaru's[/url] caretaker. He's a graduate of Shishiku Academy. Under "Hikaru's order", he'll throw everything away to prioritize Hikaru but Hikaru is disgusted with him. As the only person who knows about Hikaru and [url=/c39873]the heroine's[/url] switch, he follows up and covers for them regarding the family's arrangements, formalities, and the like.

[Translation taken from [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2015/11/14/kenka-banchou-otome/]Otome Jikan[/url]]
